title: Kash Patel Promotes Anti-Patriot Jan 6 Prosecutor, Targeted Parents at School Meetings
text:
Strange things are afoot with the FBI.
Then again, what else is new?
Only this time, it involves Kash Patel.
He just promoted Steven Jensen.
The same Jensen that targeted and prosecuted Jan 6 patriots and parents at school board meetings.
The same one that said:
‘I don’t give a blank, they’re goddamn terrorists, and we’re gonna round them all up.’
Please define the word “terrorist”, Jensen.
So did we all just get duped into thinking Patel was on our side?
Is this a case of ‘meet the new boss, same as the old boss’ or is there something else going on?
Kash Patel told us he would shut down the FBI building and turn it into a museum on day 1
So why is he giving promotions to people who destroyed the lives of innocent Americans?
Don’t tell us to trust the plan either
https://t.co/EM6iHjyskC …
pic.twitter.com/1I2isY2nzW
— Hodgetwins (@hodgetwins) April 8, 2025
So now we’re supposed to trust Jensen?
Trust him to do what, target patriots?
Steven Jensen is now OFFICIALLY heading the Washington D.C. FBI Field Office.
Endorsed by Kash Patel and Jim Jordan.
This is the same guy who went after MANY INNOCENT AMERICANS like a lot of J6ers and parents attending school board meetings because he saw them as DOMESTIC… pic.twitter.com/FTA3OpTFxf
— The Patriot Voice (@TPV_John) April 8, 2025
Daily Mail reports:
Rioters who were pardoned by President Trump when he returned to the White House have turned on FBI boss Kash Patel after he ‘promoted their tormenter.’
Patel was an outspoken critic of the FBI, and the MAGA faithful hoped he would ‘clean up’ the department from within when Trump sensationally appointed him as the new chief.
Now, they’re feeling betrayed and abandoned after a New York Times report revealed he’d appointed agency veteran Steven Jensen his assistant director in charge of the office.
Jenson described January 6 participants as ‘terrorists’ and was integral to the department’s ability to arrest and prosecute so many of them following the storming of the Capitol.
Initially, supporters tried to play off the report as ‘fake news’, but the appointment became undeniable when Patel himself shared an X post addressing the rumor.
Richard Barnett, who was sentenced to 54 months in prison for his involvement before Trump pardoned him, lashed out at the decision on X.
‘The anger and depression is hitting hard today,’ he wrote.
He went on to accuse both Patel and his Deputy Director Dan Bongino of ‘stabbing us in the back.’
He said they ‘actually promoted one of our tormenters, Steve Jensen, into a position of great power within the FBI.’
Another said Patel and Bongino ‘owe The People an explanation about the promotion of Steven Jensen – who obviously hates Trump voters – to one of the most powerful FBI positions in America.’
Philip Anderson, who describes himself as a ‘January 6 survivor’, was equally critical.
‘Dan Bongino and Kash Patel betrayed us all,’ he wrote. ‘They promoted Steven Jensen who viciously persecuted J6ers.
‘It has never been more clear that Pam Bondi, Dan, and Kash have no intention whatsoever of arresting the democrat criminals.’
Derrick Evans, who said he was held as a ‘political prisoner’ after the riots, added: ‘Seriously Kash? Why the f**k does this guy have a job, let alone a promotion?’
According to a former FBI supervisory intelligence analyst who testified at the House Weaponization Committee, Jenson was hellbent on catching and imprisoning anyone involved in the January 6 riots.
Jenson reportedly said: ‘I don’t give a blank, they’re goddamn terrorists, and we’re gonna round them all up.’
I’m shook that Kash Patel and Dan Bongino are supporting the dude that put moms on a watch list and hunted J6ers
wtf is going on? This ain’t fake news y’all https://t.co/78CWbQII7Q
— Hodgetwins (@hodgetwins) April 6, 2025
Lots of patriots are scratching their heads over this one.
So, I guess it’s true… Kash Patel Patel did promote Steven Jensen as the Assistant Director in Charge of the FBI Washington Field Office..
I honestly don’t know what to think about this.
• Jensen helped unfairly prosecute J6’ers and felt no remorse for his actions.
—— “I… pic.twitter.com/LpeLZ69bKK
— MJTruthUltra (@MJTruthUltra) April 8, 2025
